title: Repository-idle detection misses supervisors launched with --repo from another directory
reasoning: The CLI can target an arbitrary checkout through --repo, but active-process detection associates recognized processes only with their cwd. A supervisor started elsewhere while targeting this repository is omitted, permitting overlapping queue, checkpoint, Git, or repair operations.
reproduction: From /tmp, run clawpatch-supervise --repo /target/repo. _active_clawpatch_processes(Path("/target/repo")) excludes it because /tmp is not the target Git root.
recommendation: Parse --repo and --repo= for supervisor processes, resolve relative targets against their cwd, and compare the resulting Git root. A repository-scoped exclusive lock would also close process-scan races.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests covering a --repo target different from process cwd were supplied.
suggestedRegressionTest: Model or launch a supervisor with cwd=/tmp and --repo=/target/repo, then assert it is active for /target/repo.
minimumFixScope: Correct target-repository resolution in clawpatch_release.py and add focused process-detection tests.
